item.title: Meshery Server Registration
item.description: Layer5 Cloud is a Meshery remote provider. When a Meshery Server uses Layer5 Cloud, hosted or self-hosted, the server registers itself with Cloud on behalf of the signed-in user. Registration is what makes that Meshery Server known to Cloud: it appears as a meshery connection owned by that user. This page explains what the server sends, how Cloud tells a new server from one it already knows, what survives re-registration, and what each failure means.

item.title: Google Drive
item.description:
The Google Drive connection is rolling out. It needs a Layer5 Cloud release that includes it, so you may not see it on a Layer5 Cloud deployment that has not been updated yet. The connection screens are still being finished, so the steps below describe each step in general terms rather than quoting button labels.

A Google Drive connection lets Layer5 Cloud fetch media files that you pick from your Google Drive. Your files stay in your Drive. Layer5 does not copy them into long-term storage.
